title: Model
answers: Answers your questions and writes drafts
key_optional: Key (only if the endpoint needs one)
key_help: The key stays in the keychain of this computer. Anagram does not show it again.
key_kept: The key is in the keychain of this computer.
sources_none: Add a source. Then choose here which sources this model may read.
lab_refuses: Your lab does not permit this model to read the lab space.
remove_confirm: Anagram removes {name}, its saved key, and its source permissions from this computer.
spend_help: A cloud model works only inside a spend limit. Anagram stops the calls at the limit.
where_local_help: Ollama runs the model. It costs nothing.
where_university_help: A model that your university runs for you.
where_cloud_help: Anthropic, OpenAI, or OpenRouter, with your own key. It costs money.
where_local_lab: On the computer of each member
where_university_lab: A model that the university runs
where_university_help_lab: All members use the same address.
where_cloud_help_lab: Each member types their own key and pays for their own use.
leaves_local_lab: Nothing leaves the computers of the members.
leaves_university: The text of the sources that you permit goes to {name}.
leaves_cloud: The text of the sources that you permit goes to {name}, and {name} bills you for each call.
leaves_lab_text: Text of the lab space can go to {name}.
leaves_lab_private: Text of the lab space stays on the computers of the members. Only private text that a member permits goes to {name}.
lab_text: This model may read the text of the lab space
local_one: Ollama runs on this computer with {model}.
ollama_none: Ollama does not run on this computer. Get it from ollama.com, open it, then look again.
ollama_empty: Ollama runs, but it has no model. Add one in Ollama, for example qwen2.5:7b, then look again.
ollama_all: You use each model that Ollama has. Add a different one in Ollama, then look again.
route_help: OpenRouter sends your text only to this provider, for example anthropic or openai.
price_in: Input price, USD for 1 million tokens
price_out: Output price, USD for 1 million tokens
prices_help: Anagram uses these prices to track your spend limit.
lab_help: The default model of each member. A member can choose a different model for their private items.
lab_each: Ollama on the computer of each member
lab_text_out: Can go to the lab model
lab_text_home: Stays on the computers of the members
lab_key_each: Each member types their own key for this model in Account.
